text:
noah: Hey IT, just unboxed my workstation. Monitor arrived but the USB-C -> DisplayPort adapter is missing from the box. Also my Magic Trackpad 2 keeps disconnecting — shows up in Bluetooth prefs but gestures and clicks don't register. Can someone help? Ticket #4862
parcel-bot: Package scanned delivered by FedEx at 10:42 AM. Manifest lists: MacBook, monitor, keyboard. Adapter not listed.
Alex (IT): Sorry about that, @noah — we'll ship a replacement adapter today. Quick Q: in System Settings is the trackpad listed as 'Not Paired' or 'Connected'? Also try holding the trackpad power button for ~3s until the LED blinks while Bluetooth prefs is open.
noah: It shows as 'Connected' but acts like it's asleep. Will try the hold now. macOS 13.4 on the Mac.
sam (buddy): fwiw I had that on 13.4 — toggling Handoff fixed it for me once. System Settings -> General -> AirDrop & Handoff -> toggle Handoff off/on.
Alex (IT): Good call. If that doesn't work, unpair and re-pair. Also run and paste this output if possible: `system_profiler SPBluetoothDataType | grep -A4 "Magic Trackpad"`
noah: Ran it, snippet: "Magic Trackpad: Address: XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX; Connected: Yes; Battery Level: 78%"
Alex (IT): Battery looks fine. Try: Settings -> Bluetooth -> Remove device -> hold trackpad until LED flashes -> re-add. I'm creating an RMA for the adapter now. Shipping: UPS 1Z999AA10123456784, est 2 business days.
it-bot: Ticket #4862 updated: Replacement adapter shipped, tracking 1Z999AA10123456784, ETA 2026-04-02. Reply to this thread if the pairing or adapter issue persists and we'll escalate to hardware.
noah: Re-pair + toggling Handoff worked — trackpad is solid now. Also hooray for the adapter shipping :tada:
sam (buddy): welcome aboard! :wave: if you want a desk-tour later lmk
matt-hw: If Bluetooth gets flaky again ping me. Sometimes killing the daemon helps: `sudo pkill bluetoothd` (mac will restart it). Also file a quick note in the ticket if you end up using a 3rd-party dongle so we can adjust future packing lists.
